name: Flamingo (WordPress plugin, message storage for Contact Form 7)
note: Public releases fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs, never vendored. 2.6.2 is the vulnerable target, 2.6.3 the fixed control. WordPress.org builds these zips from the SVN tag, so a re-committed tag can change the bytes: the sha256 stays pinned and a mismatch means re-pin after diffing, never skip the check. The fix diff was computed zip against zip (includes/capabilities.php, includes/class-contact.php, includes/class-inbound-message.php). `released` is the newest file date inside each zip.

advisories.type: Missing authorization: contact tags and channel terms readable through core APIs by any contributor
